description.narrative: (USAID South Asia Regional): This mechanism serves as the linchpin of the USG's Global Climate Ambition Initiative and the Indo-Pacific Vision. It is designed to facilitate collaboration among six countries of operation to accelerate the transition to clean energy, develop renewables to mitigate climate change, and promote energy security, economic development, livelihoods, improved health and productivity throughout the region..It will capitalize on clean energy commitments made by South Asian countries to drive economic growth. It will enhance climate ambition and enable the transformation required to reach net-zero emissions by 2050 by addressing key barriers to clean energy growth, including poor regulations, insufficient infrastructure and lack of institutional and human capacity. FY 2021 funding will be used to further USAID's goal of transitioning the region from bilateral to trilateral and multilateral power trade and the development of regional energy markets to help countries develop their renewable energy resources. This will be done by supporting an enabling policy and regulatory framework, strengthening institutions, building capacities and promoting knowledge sharing. Regional forums and mechanisms created to drive faster adoption of advanced and clean energy technologies and systems such as the South Asia Distribution Utilities Network, South Asia Forum for System Operators, Smart Grid Knowledge Center and other similar initiatives will be supported through secretariat services including technical studies and workshops. The mechanism will engage existing regional institutions such as BIMSTEC, SAFIR and SAARC and other multilateral agencies to collaborate and leverage existing work. It will also support the implementation of Government of India's One-World-One Sun-One Grid initiative to support India's 450 GW of renewable energy target through feasibility studies, capacity building and creation of a political consensus among South Asian countries..
